identificationModule.briefTitle: Zoledronic Acid in Children (1 -17 Years) With Severe Osteogenesis Imperfecta
identificationModule.officialTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Zoledronic Acid in Children (1 -17 Years) With Severe Osteogenesis Imperfecta

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is an extension study to examine the long-term safety and efficacy of zoledronic acid in patients who have completed the core CZOL446H2202 study.

keywords: Osteogenesis Imperfecta, Brittle bone disease, bisphosphonate, children

primaryOutcomes.measure: Long-term safety of two different zoledronic acid doses over an additional 12 months in patients who have completed one year treatment in CZOL446H2202

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Measure percentage change of lumbar spine bone mineral density at month 18 and 24 compared to baseline in the core study.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Have completed the core CZOL446H2202 study
* Males or females between 1-17 years of age

Exclusion Criteria:

* Deformity or abnormality which would prevent spine bone density from being done
* Any surgical bone-lengthening procedure
* Any kidney diseases or abnormalities
* Low calcium or vitamin D levels in the blood

Other protocol-defined inclusion/exclusion criteria may apply.
